prompts.paving: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable game ground material, square, viewed exactly straight down with no perspective. Paint a polished handcrafted MOBA pavement texture for an overgrown futuristic military outpost: large irregular slate and weathered warm-gray concrete paving pieces, carefully painted bevel highlights, deep narrow dark grout, a few broad fractured slabs, restrained olive moss only in joints, occasional worn metal seam inserts. Deliberate painterly brushwork, cool blue-gray shadows and warm muted stone faces. Strong readable material depth at gameplay zoom, medium-scale shapes, rich but restrained colors. Fill the whole square edge to edge with continuous tileable texture. Lighting is soft diffuse painted material shading, not a dramatic cast shadow. No structures, objects, characters, roads painted on top, text, borders, UI, perspective, photoreal grain, glossy surfaces, repetitive tiny brick grid, or heavy bright white cracks. Maintain matching edges for repeating this texture over a large world.
prompts.woodland: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable ground material for a hand-painted 3D MOBA, square, exact straight-down orthographic view. Lush but readable woodland floor around an abandoned science-fiction outpost. Paint broad natural clumps of desaturated moss and short olive/sage grass, dark green-blue damp soil pockets, warm earth under a few tiny fallen leaves, scattered small embedded gray stones, subtle shallow roots. Excellent stylized game-art brushwork, soft organic color fields, painted depth around grass clumps and stones; no photoreal photograph or micrograin. Mostly green vegetation with some open shaded earth. Continuous detail across all edges, no isolated central subject, no trees, shrubs, large objects, buildings, characters, text, border, cast-shadow silhouette, perspective, or UI. Match the muted forest greens and warm stone in handcrafted MOBA battlegrounds; readable, rich midtones, not oversaturated neon green.
